info.title: Interop Resolution Service
info.description: Onyx's interop lookups. Member resolution, POST /v1/interop/resolve: resolves an EMR-supplied member ID against the plan's member records, reports whether coverage is active on the date of service, and returns the ID as resolved and in every UM vendor's format, each with the payer for that vendor's request.

tags.name: Member resolution
tags.description: Resolve an EMR-supplied member id against the plan's member records for a date of service

post.summary: Resolve a member id for a date of service
post.description: Finds the member behind the id the EMR typed, says whether coverage is active on the date of service (or on every day of a period of service), and returns the id as resolved and in every configured UM vendor's format (memberId.forVendors), each entry with the payer for that vendor's request (payerId, payerName). When several members on the plan match and no dateOfBirth settles it, the outcome is AMBIGUOUS and the message says what to resend; the other members are never listed. clientId, clientType (EXT or INT), requestId and memberId are required; unknown properties are ignored. A sent date is the date evaluated; an unusable date is a 400. POST because the member id is PHI and must not appear in URLs; the operation is a pure read and may be repeated.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Optional transport-level id for the call, 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'; echoed in the response header and in error bodies as correlationId, or generated when missing or invalid

200.description: outcome ACTIVE | INACTIVE | NOT_FOUND | AMBIGUOUS; memberId.forVendors, each vendor with its payer, present for ACTIVE and INACTIVE

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST for a missing or unusable clientId, clientType or requestId, a missing memberId, an unusable date or a body that is not JSON; MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED when the member lookup answered 400 (details[0].code HTTP_400, the lookup's text in the message)

422.description: DOB_MISMATCH: the date of birth matches no record for this id

404.description: INVALID_REQUEST / ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: wrong path; a connector defect (a member that is not found is a 200 with outcome NOT_FOUND)

405.description: INVALID_REQUEST / METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: the operation is POST only

406.description: INVALID_REQUEST / NOT_ACCEPTABLE: the service answers application/json only

415.description: INVALID_REQUEST / UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: the request body must be application/json

502.description: MEMBER_LOOKUP_ERROR or MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSE (the member lookup); MEMBER_PLAN_ERROR or MEMBER_PLAN_INVALID_RESPONSE (the member plan lookup)

503.description: MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE or MEMBER_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE; retry after the Retry-After seconds

500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR: the service itself failed; retry once later, then alert the service owners with the correlationId and requestId

MemberResolutionRequest.description: Member resolution request: clientId, clientType, requestId and memberId are required; unknown properties are ignored; a sent date must be usable

clientId.description: The calling system, as registered with the plan: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', at most 50 characters

clientType.description: EXT for a caller outside the plan, INT for an internal one

requestId.description: The caller's id for this call, unique per request; echoed in the response and in every error response. Letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-', at most 64 characters

memberId.description: The member id exactly as the EMR supplied it. Looked up unchanged (surrounding whitespace removed); the service never checks its shape, length or characters. For instance a THP Medicare card number is a letter and 8 digits; the example is that pattern, masked

dateOfService.description: Date of service, yyyy-MM-dd; the first date when the service covers a period. Omitted, null or blank: today in US Eastern time (America/New_York) is used, dateOfServiceDefaulted is true and the answer's dateOfService says which date was used; send the date whenever you have it. A sent value is the date evaluated: any future date is judged on the coverage on record; not a real date (DATE_OF_SERVICE_INVALID), or more than 10 years back (DATE_OF_SERVICE_OUT_OF_RANGE), is a 400.

dateOfServiceEnd.description: Optional last date of service, yyyy-MM-dd, when the service covers a period: coverage must hold on every day from dateOfService to it. Not before dateOfService; needs dateOfService. Omitted, null or blank counts as not sent.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional patient date of birth, yyyy-MM-dd, used only to verify the member or to tell apart the members on a plan who share the id. Omitted, null or blank counts as not sent. Not a real date is a 400 (DATE_OF_BIRTH_INVALID); in the future or more than 125 years ago is a 400 (DATE_OF_BIRTH_OUT_OF_RANGE). Never logged, never echoed.

Coverage.description: The coverage flag and the continuous coverage period that covers the (first) date of service. The dates are present when active, and when inactive only because the period ends before the last date asked about; otherwise absent, and message says why

coverageId.description: An id for the coverage period: the resolved id reduced to letters and digits, then the effective and end dates as yyyyMMdd, run together with no separator (39991231 for an open-ended period). Present whenever the dates are; the same member with the same coverage always gets the same value

active.description: The flag: true when coverage holds on the date of service, or on every day of the period of service

effectiveDate.description: First day of the coverage period

endDate.description: Last day of the coverage period; 3999-12-31 for an open-ended period

MemberId.description: The member id as received, as resolved, and in every vendor's format

received.description: The member id as sent, surrounding whitespace removed

resolved.description: The id the lookup resolved to, as the plan stores it; for a converted member a different number from the one received. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only

forVendors.description: The resolved id in every configured vendor's format, each with the payer for that vendor's request; one entry per vendor, sorted by vendor code. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only

MemberResolutionResponse.description: The answer: the outcome Onyx branches on, one sentence for a person, the member id as received, as resolved and in every vendor's format with that vendor's payer, the line of business, the date evaluated, the coverage flag with its period, the caller's requestId and a traceId for support. A field that does not apply is absent, never null

outcome.description: ACTIVE: member found, coverage active on the date of service (or on every day of the period). INACTIVE: member found, not covered on that date or not on every day of the period; message says why. NOT_FOUND: no member for this id on that date. AMBIGUOUS: several members match and nothing sent tells them apart; message says what to resend

message.description: One sentence for a person reading the answer. Branch on outcome, not on this text

lineOfBusiness.description: The line of business Onyx routes on, from the plan in effect on the date of service: SCO, MA-HMO, MA-PPO, D-SNP, MA-TOGETHER, RI-TOGETHER or MA-QHP. When no rule applies, the member record's own category is passed through (MCR, PP, COM today; other values may appear), and the field is absent when the record carries none. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only. Agree with Point32Health how to route a value outside the list, or an absent one

dateOfService.description: The date evaluated; the first date when a period was asked about

dateOfServiceEnd.description: The last date evaluated; present only when the request asked about a period

dateOfServiceDefaulted.description: true when no dateOfService was sent and today was used

coverage.description: The coverage flag and the coverage period behind it. ACTIVE and INACTIVE only

traceId.description: The id of the member lookup behind this answer; quote it to support

sourceMessage.description: What the member lookup said when it had no member for the id. NOT_FOUND only, and only when the lookup sent a message

SourceMessage.description: What the member lookup said when it had no member for the id, forwarded as it came

type.description: The message type as the lookup sent it

status.description: The status as the lookup sent it

code.description: The message code as the lookup sent it

text.description: The message text as the lookup sent it

VendorMemberId.description: Everything Onyx puts on one vendor's request

memberId.description: The resolved id in this vendor's format: the member id to put on this vendor's request

payerId.description: The payer id to put on this vendor's request; it differs by vendor and by the member's heritage company, so use the entry's value as given

payerName.description: The payer name that goes with payerId

ApiErrorResponse.description: The shape of every non-200 answer

correlationId.description: The X-Correlation-Id of the call, echoed or generated

requestId.description: The caller's requestId, when the request carried a usable one

traceId.description: The id of the member lookup behind the answer, present once the lookup was made

Error.description: The error: a stable code to branch on, a message for a person, and one detail per problem

code.description: INVALID_REQUEST, MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED, DOB_MISMATCH, MEMBER_LOOKUP_ERROR, MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSE, MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE, MEMBER_PLAN_ERROR, MEMBER_PLAN_INVALID_RESPONSE, MEMBER_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE or INTERNAL_ERROR

details.description: One entry per problem found; every problem with a request is reported together

ErrorDetail.description: One problem inside an error response

field.description: The request field the problem is about, when there is one

code.description: The detail code that refines error.code, for example MEMBER_ID_MISSING, DATE_OF_SERVICE_INVALID, HTTP_400, READ_TIMEOUT
